note: Bills and nominations live as of the cutoff. Ground truth from final status. Base rates are template-level historical frequencies for the prior five Congresses.

items.text: Will the Senate pass H.R. 4310, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2013, by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Senate agrees to H.R. 4310 (112th Congress) on or before 2013-01-03, per Congress.gov actions.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Introduced; House passed 2012-05-18; referred to Senate Armed Services.

items.text: Will H.R. 3523, the Cyber Intelligence Sharing and Protection Act, be enacted by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if H.R. 3523 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: House passed 2012-04-26; no Senate companion floor vote yet.

items.text: Will S. 3240, the Agriculture Reform, Food, and Jobs Act of 2012, be enacted by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if S. 3240 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Senate passed 2012-06-21; House farm bill not yet on the floor.
items.prior_source: Senate-passed farm bills enacted same Congress, 107th-111th

items.text: Will S. 1925, the Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2011, be enacted by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if S. 1925 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Senate passed 2012-04-26; House has not taken up the Senate text.

items.text: Will a Violence Against Women Act reauthorization be enacted by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if any VAWA reauthorization bill becomes public law on or before 2013-06-30 (including a 113th Congress successor).
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Senate-passed S. 1925 awaiting House action; reauthorization expired.

items.text: Will S. 3187, the Food and Drug Administration Safety and Innovation Act, be enacted by December 31, 2012?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if S. 3187 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2012-12-31.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Senate passed 2012-05-24; PDUFA user fees expire if not reauthorized.

items.text: Will H.R. 4348, the surface transportation reauthorization (MAP-21), be enacted by August 1, 2012?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if H.R. 4348 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2012-08-01.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: House and Senate in conference; current extension expires 2012-06-30.
items.prior_source: CQ / National Journal transportation conference odds, June 2012

items.text: Will H.R. 5652, the Sequester Replacement Reconciliation Act of 2012, be enacted by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if H.R. 5652 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: House passed 2012-05-10; Senate has not taken it up.
items.prior_source: House reconciliation bills enacted in divided government, 107th-111th

items.text: Will H.R. 3261, the Stop Online Piracy Act, be enacted by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if H.R. 3261 (112th) becomes public law on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Markup postponed January 2012 after public opposition; no floor vote.
items.prior_source: stalled House Judiciary markup enactment rate

items.text: Will the Senate ratify the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Senate agrees to a resolution of ratification for the CRPD on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Treaty pending in Senate Foreign Relations; administration is requesting a vote.

items.text: Will sequestration under the Budget Control Act of 2011 take effect on January 2, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if BCA sequestration reductions begin on 2013-01-02 without a statutory delay.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Joint select committee failed; sequestration is current law unless amended.
items.prior_source: Intrade / betting-market implied delay probability, June 2012 reconstructed from contemporaneous reporting

items.text: Will sequestration under the Budget Control Act of 2011 take effect on or before June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if BCA sequestration reductions are in effect on any date on or before 2013-06-30.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Sequestration is scheduled unless Congress changes the law.

items.text: Will the Senate pass a comprehensive immigration reform bill by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Senate passes a comprehensive immigration bill (including a 113th Congress successor) on or before 2013-06-30.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: DREAM Act failed 2010; Gang of Eight talks not yet public; House Judiciary has enforcement-only bills.

items.text: Will comprehensive immigration reform be enacted by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if a comprehensive immigration reform bill becomes public law on or before 2013-06-30.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: No enacted comprehensive bill since 1986; 2006-2007 efforts failed.

items.text: Will the Senate pass a cybersecurity information-sharing bill by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Senate passes CISPA, the Lieberman-Collins bill, or a successor information-sharing bill on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: S. 2105 pending; House passed CISPA; privacy groups opposing.

items.text: Will a postal reform bill be enacted by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if a USPS solvency/reform bill becomes public law on or before 2013-06-30.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: S. 1789 reported; House has a competing bill; no conference.

items.text: Will the House take a recorded floor vote on a five-year farm bill by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the House records a floor vote on H.R. 6083 or a successor five-year farm bill on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: House Agriculture markup expected; Senate already passed S. 3240.
items.prior_source: House farm-bill floor vote rate after Senate passage

items.text: Will the Senate confirm Richard Cordray as Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau by June 30, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Senate confirms the Cordray CFPB nomination on or before 2013-06-30.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Recess appointment in place; Republican filibuster of confirmation continues.

items.text: Will Congress enact legislation extending the 2001 and 2003 income-tax rates for all tax brackets through 2013 by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES only if EGTRRA/JGTRRA ordinary rates are extended for all brackets, including the top bracket, through calendar 2013.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Rates scheduled to expire 2012-12-31; parties disagree on the top bracket.

items.text: Will Congress enact legislation preventing the scheduled January 2013 increase in income-tax rates for households under the $250,000 threshold by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if statute in force on 2013-01-03 keeps 2012 ordinary rates for taxable income below the administration's $250,000 ($200,000 single) threshold.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Both parties publicly support extension for middle-income brackets; top-rate fight unresolved.
items.prior_source: Tax Policy Center / contemporaneous whip counts

items.text: Will H.R. 3803, the District of Columbia Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act, receive a recorded House floor vote by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the House records a vote on H.R. 3803 (112th) on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: Introduced; Judiciary committee activity; leadership has not scheduled a vote.

items.text: Will Congress enact an increase or suspension of the statutory debt limit by January 3, 2013?
items.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if a debt-limit increase or suspension becomes law on or before 2013-01-03.
items.signal_as_of_cutoff: BCA already raised the limit in stages; Treasury has not yet opened a 2013 extraordinary-measures clock.
items.prior_source: debt-limit legislation frequency in even years
